authorization: User authorized one hour total; coordinating thread instructed same-session follow-up

response.hypothesis: Under Predicate S, which holds for the benchmark's ("f","frequency") sweep, all 101 per-frequency noise matrices are bitwise identical. Building one (751,751) matrix and contracting it with einsum('ij,dbj->dbi') is mathematically exact. It should remove the (101,751,751) complex128 forward residual (911,393,616 bytes by shape). Reading the source, that residual is very probably stored today, because the benchmark returns the pullback from the forward JIT stage. Removing it should lower peak RSS and possibly execution time. Rounding differences may still fail the strict gradient comparison on any coordinate. None of this is measured.
